"Riz" |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]'' establishes that the [[stormtrooper]]s of the [[Galactic Empire]] were all [[human]]s. |gender=[[Gender|Female]]{{StoryCite|story=Ending Protocol|book=From a Certain Point of View: Return of the Jedi}} |pronouns=She/her |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Blond]] |feathers= |eyes= |skin= |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Empire]] **[[NE-034's contingent]] |masters= |apprentices= }} '''RZ-440''', nicknamed "'''Riz'''," was a [[Gender|female]] [[stormtrooper]] who patrolled the [[forest]] [[moon]] [[Endor]] along with [[GR-792]]. During the [[Battle of Endor]], GR-792 almost [[Death|killed]] [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], but missed after RZ-440 accidentally kicked his leg, which made the blaster strike Organa in the shoulder. RZ-440 and GR-792 approached Organa and the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]], only for GR-792 to be shot at by Organa and RZ-440 to faint by his side. Once she had awoken, she met Organa in the [[Bright Tree Village]] and asked if she could have access to the area, with Organa telling her she would talk to her superiors. {{Char-stub}} ==Appearances== *{{Film|VI}} {{1st}} *{{StoryCite|story=Ending Protocol|book=From a Certain Point of View: Return of the Jedi|audiobook=1}} {{1stID|RZ-440}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Galactic Empire deserters]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]] [[Category:Stormtroopers of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Tempest Force members]]
